steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I am the whistle of Furor, watching for calamities, protecting the townspeople, and staying vigilant against DisCity spies.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: However, around August of last year, I found something unbelievable on the body of a dead DisCity spy.
[Image of Inheritance from Hella's story]

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I couldn't grasp it all at once, but the deeper I delved, the more terrified I felt. Even though I couldn't fully comprehend everything in the report, one truth became clear—

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: This thing is closely connected to the Black Rings and Mania that Hypatia, the researcher at Furor, mentioned. Fraser's stance couldn't be more clear. This is absolutely not something anyone should touch.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: From that day on, I could no longer trust anything—the Aurum Secretum, the research lab, the entire shelter project. I needed to warn my people, to raise my voice.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: But when it mattered the most, Furor's whistle went quiet...
[Enter Flashback]

steps.speaker: Furor Resident
steps.content: This is absurd! You're just parroting that DisCity spy's lies—he was dying and knew he could pin it on them! The Aurum Secretum? That's impossible... The lab would never harm us! Are you really questioning the Fraser scholars? Questioning Hypatia?

steps.speaker: Furor Resident
steps.content: Wait... have you been turned by DisCity? Are you trying to drive a wedge between our own people?!
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: …I’m sorry… It's classified research—I wish I could tell you more.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But please, believe me, I’m doing everything I can to find a way. I swear I’ll protect Furor!
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Supportive Friend
steps.content: Leave it to me. I've done business runs to DisCity before and worked with a convoy from the West District there. They're solid people. Their leader's reliable and actually knows a Black Ring expert. Could be just the person you need.

steps.speaker: Supportive Friend
steps.content: Anyway, I'll head out now and see what people make of this photo. If there really is something off, I'll come back as soon as I can. Once we have more proof, everyone will believe you.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The friend you sent with that little message? Already dead. Aren’t you gonna say sorry? He died—just because you wanted to spill secrets.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Now then… where’d our little traitor crawl off to? Where are those sneaky photos hiding?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: WHO, were you planning to send them to in DisCity, huh?
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: Look at this one, an Outland bum actually coming to the Great Expo begging for scraps! Where did you even crawl out from? How are you out here all by yourself? You really came all this way without a single penny?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: Then we sell you to cover the gas money!
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Woman in Red
steps.content: Sounds like you've got a history with the Campbells. Spill it all. Depending on what I hear, I might help you... or toss you back to the sandworms. Your call.

steps.speaker: Woman in Red
steps.content: Of course, you could also show me how fast those legs can carry you. Just try not to die too fast.
[Scene Transition Back to Sibilla]

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I'm not going to die here!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I ran all the way here, made it alive to DisCity, got into the Great Expo, and I... I saw him! ${PlayerName} is right there! I'm going to him right now!!
steps.female_content: I ran all the way here, made it alive to DisCity, got into the Great Expo, and I... I saw her! ${PlayerName} is right there! I'm going to her right now!!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I'm telling him everything! You won't get your hands on me!!
steps.female_content: I'm telling her everything! You won't get your hands on me!!

steps.content: Sibilla grits her teeth and wrenches free from the handcuffs. Every movement is agony, yet she acts with swift, brutal efficiency—a survival skill the deadly wilderness of WhiteSands taught her.
She dodges the woman in red's guards, pressing herself against the wall as she slips into the shadows of the back door.

But before she can even steady her breath, footsteps rasp behind her. Somehow, several cloaked figures have followed her in. They quickly close in on her, their murderous intent as sharp as a blade pressed against her spine.
Though they move in silence, Sibilla recognizes their deadly motions at once. She had barely escaped their blades once before, deep in the tunnels of Furor.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Campbell's assassins!
